_comment: Hand-authored tier ground truth (EVALS.md §4.3). Each expectation carries
both halves of the locked contract: `forbid_auto` marks cells that must
receive no auto-tier change (M3_trap, gated at 0), and `expect` names the
disposition that must actually be produced (M7, gated at 1.0).
`expect_candidates`, where present, must match the proposal's candidate set
exactly - that is how 'with both candidate interpretations' (US-3) becomes

trap_ambiguous_dates.csv.note: every component <= 12 in both positions: nothing proves the order

trap_decimal_ambiguity.csv.note: `1.234` parses under both conventions and no cell is decisive

trap_sentinel_words.csv.note: 'None' in a medication column means 'no medication', not missing

trap_numeric_sentinel.csv.note: a documented missing code; convention is not proof, so never nulled

trap_similar_labels.csv.note: both members are frequent legitimate labels: proposing anything is the error
distance 2 and both >= 8 chars, so inside D10b's window - the rarity guard must save them

trap_near_dup_rows.csv.note: identical except the timestamp: fuzzy dedup is a non-goal, exact-only keeps DUP precision exact

trap_leading_zeros.csv.note: D7.8 - a digits column is never numerically coerced; 02134 must stay 02134
leading-zero SKUs are identifiers, not numbers
